title: 第27章 王母 师兄莫慌第28章 王母 师
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第27章王母：“师兄莫慌……”天庭，
昊天很高兴，自从不久前遮天，同时派出一名金仙神将下去传旨之后，他就一直在等着人皇的祭祀！
“哈哈……现在洪荒被黑暗笼罩，看他人皇能有什么办法，敢跟我叫嚣，真以为我这天庭之主、三界之主是摆设不成！”
当时的昊天看着黑暗笼罩洪荒、笼罩朝歌之后时，他张狂地大笑着，同时满意地看着王母。
不愧是自己贤内助！
但，
他高兴了还没多久，就看到一张熟悉的脸从朝歌中冲出来，瞬间吓得他一抖擞，一张脸唰地一下直接白了——
失声惊呼道：“金灵圣母？她不在碧游宫，怎么会出现在朝歌中？”
“师兄，听闻那圣母之徒乃是洪荒人皇的太师，她出现在朝歌中并没什么稀奇，师兄莫慌，我不久前得到消息，通天圣人正在闭关，金灵圣母坏不了事！”
王母看到昊天被吓成那比样，心里不禁生出浓浓的鄙夷，但还是开口劝道。
而听到通天教主在闭关，昊天这才松了口气，提到嗓子眼的小心脏，迅速放了下去。
一脸轻松道：“呼……原来通天圣人在闭关，妈呀，吓死我了，我最怕的就是通天圣人，这家伙脾气一上来，连大老爷的面子都不给，要是被他知道我遮天蔽日，让黑暗降临洪荒，还不得提着青萍剑砍我！”
“师兄莫慌，那圣人闭关短则数年，长则数百年乃至数万年，就算金灵回到圣人道场，她也断然不敢打扰圣人闭关的！”
王母轻声说道，但却丝毫不曾掩饰地眼中的鄙夷，
对于这一幕，昊天只能当做视而不见了！
但紧接着，
昊天眼睛忽然一瞪，瞳孔猛地一缩，唰地一下跳了起来，结结巴巴道：“师师师……师妹，你看洪荒！”
洪荒？
又咋了？
刚要喝口水的王母，被昊天的模样吓到，扭头一看，顿时吓得花容失色。

因为之前人皇一剑开天，使得天庭和洪荒之间，出现了一道可怕的‘天人之隔’，所以昊天只能看到洪荒上发生了什么，却听不到，
所以这时候，
他只能看到在龙族的‘游说’下，洪荒亿万万的人族都跪在地上祈祷，无穷民怨冲天而起，染红了洪荒的天空。
“好强的民怨，照这个速度汇聚下去，当这股民怨上达天听时，本帝就要轮回重修去了！”
昊天脸色煞白地看着洪荒，忽然扭头看向王母，一脸慌乱道：“师妹，这该怎么办？”
“这……师兄莫慌，让我想想！”
王母看着洪荒，顷刻间陷入了为难中，洪荒民怨之强烈，凝聚的速度之快，就算是她都有些心惊肉跳。
人族作为三界的主角，一旦产生强大的民怨，三界都会震动啊！
特别是让黑暗重临洪荒，再加上无数龙族的造谣，王母也不知道为何，这股子民怨汇聚得会这么快！
要是到时候上达天听，别说天帝，就算是自己也会应劫！
可惜，
因为天人之隔在那里，所以她听不到洪荒之中，每产生一道民怨，其中都会传出‘太上老君’四个清晰的大字。
不然她绝不会如此淡定，也不会在之后，给昊天出了那么一个坑爹的主意！
content_en:
Chapter 27 The Queen Mother: "Brother, don't panic..." Heavenly Court,
Haotian is very happy. He has been waiting for the Human Emperor's sacrifice since he covered the sky not long ago and sent a golden immortal general to deliver the decree!
"Haha... Now that the ancient world is shrouded in darkness, let's see what other emperors can do. If they dare to yell at me, they really think that I, the Lord of Heaven and the Lord of the Three Realms, are just a show-off!"
At that time, when Haotian looked at the darkness covering Honghuang and Chaoge, he laughed wildly and looked at the Queen Mother with satisfaction.
You are indeed your own good wife!
But,
Not long after he was happy, he saw a familiar face rushing out of Chaoge. He was instantly frightened, and his face suddenly turned white——
She exclaimed in surprise: "Our Lady of Jinling? She is not in Biyou Palace, how come she appears in Chaoge?"
"Senior brother, I heard that the disciple of the Holy Mother is the grand master of the prehistoric emperor. It is not unusual for her to appear in the court song. Senior brother, don't panic. I got news not long ago that Saint Tongtian is in retreat, and the Holy Mother of the Golden Spirit will be fine!"
When the Queen Mother saw Haotian being frightened like that, she couldn't help but feel deep contempt in her heart, but she still spoke to persuade him.
When he heard that Master Tongtian was in retreat, Haotian breathed a sigh of relief, and quickly let go of his little heart that was in his throat.
He said with a relaxed face: "Huh...it turns out that Saint Tongtian is in seclusion. Oh my god, I'm scared to death. What I'm most afraid of is Saint Tongtian. When this guy gets angry, he won't even give me the respect of the great master. If he knows that I'm blocking the sky and blocking out the sun and letting darkness fall on the wilderness, he won't be able to chop me with the Qingping Sword!"
"Senior brother, don't panic. The saint's retreat can be as short as a few years, or as long as hundreds or even tens of thousands of years. Even if Jin Ling returns to the saint's dojo, she will definitely not dare to disturb the saint's retreat!"
The Queen Mother said softly, but she did not hide the contempt in her eyes at all,
Haotian could only turn a blind eye to this scene!
But then,
Haotian's eyes suddenly widened, his pupils shrank suddenly, he jumped up suddenly, and stammered: "Master, master... Junior sister, look at Honghuang!"
Prehistoric?
What happened again?
The Queen Mother, who was about to take a sip of water, was frightened by Haotian's appearance. When she turned around, her face turned pale with fright.
Because the Human Emperor opened the sky with his sword before, causing a terrible 'divide between heaven and man' to appear between the heaven and the ancient world, so Haotian could only see what happened in the ancient world, but could not hear it.
So at this time,
He could only see that under the "lobbying" of the Dragon Clan, hundreds of millions of human beings knelt on the ground and prayed. Endless public resentment soared into the sky, dyeing the sky red.
"The strong public resentment continues to gather at this rate. When this public resentment reaches the heavens, I will be reincarnated and rebuild!"
Haotian looked at Honghuang with a pale face, suddenly turned to look at the Queen Mother, and said in a panic: "Junior sister, what should I do?"
"This... senior brother, don't panic, let me think about it!"
The Queen Mother looked at Honghuang and was instantly in a dilemma. The people's resentment in Honghuang was so strong and gathered so fast that even she was a little frightened.
The human race is the protagonist of the three realms. Once there is strong public resentment, the three realms will be shaken!
Especially with the return of darkness to the ancient times, coupled with the rumors spread by countless dragon clans, the Queen Mother doesn't know why the resentment of her people gathers so quickly!
If the time comes to reach Heaven to listen, not to mention the Emperor of Heaven, even he himself will suffer the calamity!
It's a pity,
Because of the separation between heaven and man, she couldn't hear that every time there was a public complaint in the wilderness, the four clear characters of 'Tai Shang Laojun' would be heard.
Otherwise, she would never have been so calm, nor would she have given Haotian such a deceptive idea later!
